properties.description: Every presented data beat matches the ordered accepted input prefix or justified zero padding, including its last marker, regardless of ready.
Every presented header matches the next completed accepted frame, with original length, clamped length, padding and truncation. Header progress is independent of data progress.
Blocked data retains valid, byte and last until transfer or synchronous reset.
Blocked headers retain valid and all status fields until transfer or synchronous reset.
Reset clears response valids and cancels epoch obligations without erasing earlier alarms. Unknown meaningful tracked observations and exceeded private tracking bounds cannot establish success.

At final post, combinationally require no remaining offered input, incomplete accepted frame, outstanding data or header obligation, or presented response. This completion check needs no subsequent clock edge.
